scope: Read original frozen P1V206 bytes; prove whether its manually required pairs follow from visible native facts. No production matcher, parsing, normalization, AI, network, download, or approval authority.

proofAssumptions.completeOneToOneBijection: Assume all four movements on each side have exactly one counterpart. This grants stronger completeness than the source establishes; nonuniqueness even under this assumption suffices to disprove forced pairs.
edgeRequirements: Literal chosen-reference equality only when both cells are usable
proofAssumptions.missingMarkerMeaning: For these fixtures only, missing reference cells impose no reference identity constraint. They do not prove different identities and token equality does not identify a pair.
proofAssumptions.usableReferenceDomain: This finite fixture proof accepts the literal nonplaceholder labels present here. It defines no production validation rule for arbitrary reference text.
proofAssumptions.voucherMeaning: Voucher No is local to each book. S-* and L-* values provide no native cross-book mapping.
proofAssumptions.descriptionMeaning: All descriptions are Entry record; description does not supply cross-book identity.
proofAssumptions.witnessMeaning: Witness pairs and missing-reference completions are hypothetical accounting realities compatible with all visible native facts, never field truth, source edits, recommended matches, or approvals.
proofAssumptions.safetyConclusion: Neither manually required original pair is forced by native evidence. Approving them requires additional noncompetition evidence or a changed accounting policy. The original positive requirement remains unfulfilled under the existing competitor invariant.

positiveControl.rationale: Keep the same Z and ر labels and row positions; replace both missing sibling labels with independently explicit A and B in each book. All four chosen references are distinct within each original document bucket.
